column1: Is phone ki battery life bahut acchi hai. Camera quality bhi badhiya hai aur battery do din chalti hai. Display thoda chota hai par battery life ke liye best hai.
Hotel ka room saaf tha lekin room service bahut slow thi. Breakfast buffet accha tha. Room service wale ek ghante baad aaye.
Movie ki story kamzor thi par background music zabardast tha. Hero ki acting theek thi. Background music ne hi movie bachayi.
Virat Kohli ne kal shatak banaya aur India ne match jeet liya. Kohli ki batting dekh ke maza aa gaya. Bowling bhi acchi rahi.
Delhi mein pradushan bahut badh gaya hai. Air quality index kal 400 ke paar tha. Sarkar ne schools band kar diye kyunki air quality kharab hai.
Mujhe naya laptop chahiye college ke liye. Budget chalees hazaar hai. Laptop mein achi RAM aur SSD storage honi chahiye.
Khana bahut swaadisht tha, khaas kar butter chicken. Khaana time par aaya aur delivery boy bhi polite tha. Butter chicken dobara order karunga.
Exam ki taiyari ke liye maine online coaching li. Online coaching ke teachers acche hain. Mock test har hafte hota hai.
Mumbai ki local train mein bahut bheed hoti hai. Office time pe local train pakadna mushkil hai. Metro se safar aasan hai.
Doctor ne kaha ki roz exercise karo aur sugar kam khao. Diabetes ka control diet se hota hai. Blood sugar har mahine check karo.
Is app ka user interface bahut confusing hai. Payment option dhundhne mein time lagta hai. User interface badalna chahiye.
Goa trip bahut yaadgaar rahi. Beach ke paas hotel mila tha. Water sports ka maza alag tha aur seafood bhi lajawab tha.
Petrol ke daam phir badh gaye. Aam aadmi pareshan hai kyunki mehngai badh rahi hai. Sarkar ko petrol par tax kam karna chahiye.
Shaadi mein band baaja aur dance floor ka intezaam tha. Catering team ne khana acha banaya. Dance floor par sab nache.
WiFi router baar baar disconnect hota hai. Internet speed bhi kam milti hai. Customer care ne router badalne ko bola.
Bachon ki online class ke liye tablet liya. Tablet ki screen badi hai aur battery bhi theek hai. Online class mein awaaz saaf aati hai.
Kisan andolan ko ek saal ho gaya. Kisano ki maang hai ki MSP ka kanoon bane. Sarkar aur kisan netao ki baat chal rahi hai.
Gym ki membership mehngi hai par trainer bahut accha hai. Weight loss ke liye trainer ne diet plan diya. Diet plan se teen kilo kam hue.
Is restaurant ka ambience sundar hai. Paneer tikka aur dal makhani try karo. Service charge alag se lagta hai.
Naye ghar ke liye home loan liya hai. Bank ka interest rate zyada hai. EMI har mahine salary se kat jati hai.
Bollywood gaane aajkal remix hi hote hain. Purane gaano ki melody alag thi. Kishore Kumar ki awaaz aaj bhi dil ko chhuti hai.
Bike ki service karwani thi. Service center walo ne engine oil badla aur brake pads bhi change kiye. Bill thoda zyada aaya.
Corona ke baad work from home badh gaya. Office jaana kam ho gaya hai. Work from home mein internet aur laptop zaroori hain.
Barish ki wajah se flight cancel ho gayi. Airline ne refund dene se mana kar diya. Refund ke liye consumer court jaunga.
Bank mein account kholna tha. Aadhaar card aur PAN card maange. Passbook do din mein mil gayi.
IPL final mein Chennai ne Mumbai ko haraya. Dhoni ki captaincy shandaar thi. Last over mein chhakka lagaya aur stadium gunj utha.
Is saree ka kapda bahut mulayam hai. Silk ki quality acchi hai aur rang bhi nahi utarta. Border ka design pyara hai.
Ration card banwane mein bahut paresani hui. Sarkari daftar ke chakkar lagane pade. Online form bharne ke baad bhi kaam nahi hua.
Television ki picture quality zabardast hai. Sound system bhi accha hai. Smart TV mein Netflix aur Hotstar chalta hai.
Bachpan mein gaon jaate the garmi ki chhuttiyon mein. Aam ke bagicha mein khelte the. Dadi ki kahaniyan aaj bhi yaad hain.
School fees har saal badh jati hai. Parents association ne principal se baat ki. Fees structure par committee banegi.
Yoga classes subah chhe baje hoti hain. Instructor bahut patient hai. Back pain mein yoga se kaafi aaram mila.
Metro station ke bahar auto wale zyada paise maangte hain. Meter se chalne ko koi taiyaar nahi. Traffic police ko shikayat ki.
Naya smartphone launch hua hai jisme 5G support hai. Processor fast hai aur fast charging bhi milti hai. Kimat pachees hazaar rakhi gayi hai.
Election ke pehle netaon ke vaade badh jaate hain. Berozgari sabse bada mudda hai. Voter ko soch samajh ke vote dena chahiye.
Mithai ki dukaan mein gulab jamun aur rasgulla mil raha tha. Diwali ke liye dukan par bheed thi. Gulab jamun garam the.
Coding bootcamp mein Python aur data science sikhaya gaya. Project based learning se confidence aaya. Placement team ne interview ki taiyari karwayi.
AC ki cooling kam ho gayi hai. Technician ne gas refill ki baat kahi. Warranty khatam hone ke kaaran paise dene padenge.
Cricket academy mein bachon ko batting aur fielding sikhate hain. Coach bahut anubhavi hai. Har weekend practice match hota hai.
Sabzi mandi mein tamatar aur pyaaz ke daam badh gaye. Pyaz sau rupaye kilo mil raha hai. Grihini ka budget bigad gaya.
